purpose: City-specific discovery and bounded verification of an official cadastral parcel source for Jiayuguan/嘉峪关, China; this research packet is not source integration or admission.
name: Jiayuguan

queries.query: Jiayuguan China cadastral parcel map official land registry GIS
queries.result: Found the official Jiayuguan Tianditu portal and a first-party Jiayuguan Natural Resources Bureau page identifying it as the authoritative official map; the portal's current public GeoServer WFS exposes a zongdi (宗地) layer.

queries.query: 嘉峪关 不动产登记 地籍图 官方 地图
queries.result: First-party results identify 天地图·嘉峪关 as the official Jiayuguan geographic information public-service platform and the Jiayuguan Natural Resources Bureau as its operator; the public map configuration exposes a GeoServer WMS/WFS route.

registryBasis: The official Jiayuguan Natural Resources Bureau identifies 天地图·嘉峪关 as the city's authoritative official map/geographic-information public-service platform; its public map configuration and service route expose a local Jiayuguan GeoServer with a 宗地 layer. This is local custodian and public-service evidence, not runtime adapter qualification.

officialSources.operator: 嘉峪关市自然资源局 (Jiayuguan Natural Resources Bureau)
officialSources.scope: First-party statement that 天地图·嘉峪关 is the authoritative official map site and supports natural-resources and survey-monitoring information services.

officialSources.operator: Jiayuguan geographic information public-service platform / Jiayuguan Natural Resources Bureau
officialSources.scope: Current public map viewer; its JavaScript loads the environment configuration and GeoServer WMS/WFS client route.
Public configuration naming the Jiayuguan GeoServer workspace jygserver and the city's map extent.

routesAttempted.outcome: 200/search-readable official portal. It advertises public map/API resources and identifies the local platform operator.
200. Viewer HTML inspected; it loads config/env.config.js and geoserver-wmts.js, which construct the local GeoServer WMS endpoint and use EPSG:4326 for WMS.
200. Public configuration exposed workspace jygserver and the city extent; no login, private token, CAPTCHA, Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.
200 XML, WMS 1.3.0 capabilities. Public service was reachable; available layers include thematic layers, while parcel qualification was verified through WFS.
200 XML, WFS 2.0.0 capabilities. It lists jygserver:zongdi titled 宗地 and jygserver:DLTB2022 titled 2022地类图斑; zongdi was selected as the cadastral parcel layer.
200 XML schema. Geometry is the_geom with gml:MultiSurfacePropertyType; native identity fields include OBJECTID and BDCDYH. Other source fields were not retained or requested for the sample.

200 GeoJSON, bounded anonymous response with 3 returned features and totalFeatures/numberMatched 3831. Response CRS was EPSG:4326. The retained sample keeps only the stable native feature IDs zongdi.1 through zongdi.3 and full parcel geometries; unsafe attributes were excluded.

schemaCrsAndResponse.title: 宗地
schemaCrsAndResponse.safeNativeIdentity: feature id (zongdi.<OBJECTID>); OBJECTID is also present in the schema but is not duplicated in retained properties

scopeLimits: The bounded bbox response demonstrates a public parcel layer and safe native identity, not citywide completeness or guaranteed current coverage beyond the queried extent.
The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested for retention; source schema names were recorded only as metadata.
The three retained polygons are a bounded sample only and are not an integration fixture.
This packet is research evidence only, not source integration or admission.
remainingUncertainty: The public WFS layer is reachable and returned parcel geometry, but serial review must independently qualify the adapter, identity semantics, update cadence, legal/public-use scope, and whether the layer is suitable for runtime use.
